title.zh: 基础设施保护（受保护场所）（第 4 号）命令 2023
title.vi: Lệnh Bảo vệ cơ sở hạ tầng (Địa điểm được bảo vệ) (Số 4) 2023
title.th: คำสั่งการคุ้มครองโครงสร้างพื้นฐาน (สถานที่ที่ได้รับการคุ้มครอง) (ฉบับที่ 4) 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Infrastructure Protection (Protected Places) (No. 4) Order 2023 and comes into operation on 24 February 2023.

heading.en: Premises declared to be protected places

text.en: 2. The premises described in the second column of the Schedule are declared to be protected places for the purposes of the Act, and the person specified in the first column of that Schedule is designated as the authority of the corresponding protected place.

3.—(1) In the Protected Places (No. 2) Order 2008 (G.N. No. S 124/2008), in the Schedule, delete item (2).
(2) In the Protected Places (No. 8) Order 2012 (G.N. No. S 453/2012), in the Schedule, delete item (21).
(3) In the Protected Places (No. 5) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 306/2013), in the Schedule, delete items (7) and (10).
(4) In the Protected Places (No. 6) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 307/2013), in the Schedule, delete items (13), (14) and (15).
(5) In the Protected Places (No. 7) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 308/2013), in the Schedule, delete item (7).
(6) In the Protected Places (No. 8) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 309/2013), in the Schedule, delete item (5).
(7) In the Protected Places (No. 10) Order 2013 (G.N. No. S 311/2013), in the Schedule, delete item (6).
